config.name: Raw syslog lines by the vendor table they were detected into
config.sqlTemplate:
SELECT $__timeInterval(_timestamp_load) AS ts,
       toString(_source) AS vendor,
       count() AS lines
FROM dfe.all_sources
WHERE $__timeFilter(_timestamp_load) AND toString(_json._source_original) = 'syslog'
GROUP BY ts, vendor
ORDER BY ts

config.name: Lines no detector claimed
config.sqlTemplate:
SELECT count() AS "unclaimed lines"
FROM dfe.`demo-syslog`
WHERE $__timeFilter(_timestamp_load)

config.name: Detected lines per vendor
config.sqlTemplate:
SELECT toString(_source) AS "Vendor",
       count() AS "Lines"
FROM dfe.all_sources
WHERE $__timeFilter(_timestamp_load) AND toString(_json._source_original) = 'syslog'
GROUP BY 1
ORDER BY 2 DESC
